problem: A content-derived causal_turn_id collapses two deliberately distinct byte-identical turns in the same unchanged entity generation. That confuses event identity with material identity and can misclassify a new rejected/blocked/no-commit turn as idempotent replay.

counterexample.note: The finding is documented as review evidence; repository policy/owner decides promotion.

delta.mechanism: Append-only MiniUnifiedDB allocation ids separate causal event identity from turn material digest. Every allocation is a new event; retries explicitly reuse an earlier causal_turn_id.
delta.runtime_selector_fusion: invocation selector may request activation only for an already allocated+bound turn; runtime PREPARE resolves the generation-bound active pointer, not a second selector path

invalid or unknown causal id fail-closed
